svg.title: #45 2100 SPINK ST NW, Atlanta (16.2 ac tax roll)
svg.text: #45 2100 SPINK ST NW, Atlanta (16.2 ac tax roll)
operator rear-load 260, court only, cars along office wall
Trailer stalls 12 (court rows 0, drop yard 12) vs target 12
Site 15.3 ac (county map) 7,800 SF/gross ac FAR 0.18
Access: truck (T) + car (C); local road, GDOT route 1121200072603;
Graded area: relief ~31 ft, balanced cut/fill ~21,000 CY, steep 6%
! RESIDENTIAL_EDGE: about 809 ft of boundary touches residential
parcels (county land-use codes); draft buffers applied
! ATL_PARKING_CODE: parking at the market ratio; Atlanta's 1/600
SF code minimum (unverified after the parking reforms) would need
! LOADING_FACES_RES: a truck court or trailer row is within 150 ft
of a residential edge (50 ft loading strip and screening likely)
! RELIEF: about 31 ft of relief across the graded area: terraces
! ZONING_DRAFT: setbacks and buffers are draft screening values
for atlanta; zoning_rules.json is the authority
! STREAMS_PIPELINES: stream lines and petroleum pipelines are not
mapped; mapped water, wetlands and floodplain get a 25 ft buffer
i BELOW_COMP_BAND: 7,813 SF per gross acre; Georgia comps run
i POND_SITE_FROM_LIDAR: pond placed low, near the module and on
its side of mapped wetlands; no outfall, maintenance drive or
paving envelope (draft setbacks/buffers, 25 ft from water)
Screening test fit from public data: not a survey, civil design or zoning
determination. Zoning values are draft; detention is a +/-30% estimate;
routes, fire access and grading are indicative.
